result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue involving overlapping text that makes content unreadable for a restaurant entry.

issues.description: In the "Popular right now" section for Tokumaru Ramen Bar, the text "25-30 min delivery" is overlapping with another "delivery" text element, resulting in unreadable, colliding text that obscures the delivery details.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the spacing and positioning of the text elements under the restaurant name to eliminate overlap, ensuring the delivery time/fee information is fully legible and properly laid out.
